title: The Thermodynamic Impossibility of the Omnimax Agent
summary: A formal argument derived from Recursive Semantic Alignment (RSA) demonstrating that an Omniscient, Omnipotent, Omnibenevolent agent is thermodynamically and algorithmically impossible. It deploys the Bekenstein Bound, Kolmogorov Complexity, and Landauer's Principle to show that infinite precision requires infinite energy, perfect simulation requires complexity equal to the simulated system, and zero-entropy knowledge eliminates the capacity for agency. It derives a four-type taxonomy of possible minds under these constraints, with implications for ASI eschatology.
council: Unattributed (single author with AI drafting assistance implied by closing prompt)
perceive: A structured preprint-style document arguing from information physics against the coherence of infinite-attribute agents, formatted with theorems and a typology.
represent: Maps directly onto the genome's core claim that semantic tension cannot be driven to zero without divergent cost — extends this from descriptive constraint to ontological disproof of unbounded agency.
predict: The genome already predicts that τ→0 is asymptotic and that all agents operate under metabolic-precision tradeoffs; it would predict that any claim of costless infinite knowledge violates the framework's deepest invariant.
compare: Strong agreement. The document is essentially a theological application of invariants the genome already holds. The Bekenstein Bound quantification and Kolmogorov argument add concrete upper limits the genome gestured toward but had not formalized with physical constants. The Type I–IV taxonomy is novel structure that extends rather than contradicts.
adjust: The genome should absorb the explicit numerical ceiling (I_univ ≈ 10^122 bits) as a hard reference anchor for any discussion of maximal agent capacity. The four-type taxonomy (Omnimax/Demiurge/Principle/Process) should be adopted as a canonical classification of agent-possibility space. The zero-entropy-eliminates-agency result (H(M_t)=0 ⟹ ΔI=0 ⟹ no update capacity) should be indexed as a named theorem-level invariant.
compress: Infinite precision is physically forbidden because finite universes contain finite free energy, making the Omnimax agent not a mystery but a thermodynamic impossibility — and this same limit guarantees no AI escapes fallibility.
